I've been using this product for quite a while. Freshly showered, damp skin soaks it up. I love that it is unscented.[[ASIN:B01MXOZDAB Neutrogena Body Oil, Light Sesame Oil Formula, Fragrance Free, 8.5 Fl. Oz.]]

Neutrogena Body Oil leaves skin super-soft when used after showering.  This is my favorite product to use for dry skin in the winter. It has a slight smell, which I think is very pleasant.  Product does not leave skin oily when used correctly, and solves the winter-itch problem easily.  Just a little bit rubbed on skin after shower does the trick, then pat dry, and off you go.  I always have a bottle sitting in the shower.  My skin loves it!

reviews.t: Please NEVER STOP making this great product
reviews.x: I've been using this product for years as my skin is dry.  I used to be prone to skin infections around my ankles which took forever to go away.  Since using this, I haven't had a single infection, as my moister skin seems to be able to resist better.  This is one of the few products I seriously hope they'll never stop producing.  It's very light on your skin, not heavy and greasy like all other similar products.

Wish I had read the reviews... I have used this product for years and LOVE it. When I saw that it was available with a pump from this vendor, instead of a squeeze bottle… I jumped at the opportunity to place my order. When it did not arrive with the pump I decided to go online and alert other future customers of this problem.  WAKE UP VENDOR! Take your photo down, and stop taking your customers money.

After a sandy day at the beach, I use this in the shower. I mix my neutragena rainbath liquid soap and the light sesame oil, and it gets the encrusted sand off, especially in those knooks and crannies. It leaves my skin soft and NOT OILY. It's a light thin oil. After being in the sun, it helps to prevent that "leathery" feeling.

reviews.t: Be good to your skin this winter
reviews.x: This body oil is just what you need, as the bitter cold starts to settle in and dry out the skin! Your body will soak up this sesame oil and it will stay looking hydrated and silky smooth. The body oil has no scent and pairs well with the Neutrogena Rainbath Shower Gel. Be good to your skin this winter!

Unfortunately this did pretty much nothing for my skin and might even be breaking me out :( a thin layer soaked in immediately and did not soothe dryness, but a slightly thicker later just sat on my skin. Might work for others but not for me!

One of the few oils that rally absorbs well in to my skin and keeps it hydrated in this dry climate. I use it right after drying off from a shower for best effect. Very light fragrance. Skin loves it most in the winter.

claims.text: Many customers report the product did not arrive with the pump shown in the photos, which was their main reason for purchasing.
Customers frequently praise the oil itself, saying it leaves skin soft and hydrated, especially for dry winter skin.
Some customers are disappointed that the product contains parabens.
A few customers note the scent is strong at first but fades, while others appreciate that it is unscented or lightly scented.
One customer found the product ineffective for their skin and possibly causing breakouts.
